video_overlay_text_observed: Caption-card title: "5 reasons why I think Jeffrey Epstein is still alive." Caption: "See you in ValHELLa #standup #standupcomedy #fortnite."
audio_content_summary: Standup comedy set by Sammy Obeid — a satirical 'five reasons Epstein is still alive' bit. The comedy is built around real, documented custody-failure facts (guards skipping checks and falsifying logs, cameras not recording, removed from suicide watch / cellmate gone, the contested autopsy) which it then escalates into absurd conspiracy: a body double swapped in (#JimCarrey), a decoy box-coffin sent to a hospital while the 'real body' is shipped to Israel, and an Epstein Fortnite account logging in from Tel Aviv after his death.
implied_frame: Editorial split A3/B1/C4. This is a comedy routine, not an assertion of fact — the inflammatory items are jokes. Its verifiable core is real and now documented in evidence record 2019-epstein-death-custody-001: the two guards (Tova Noel, Michael Thomas) failed required rounds and falsified the logs, nearly all SHU cameras were not recording, and Epstein had been removed from a cellmate/left alone after a July 2019 suicide-watch incident — all from the June 2023 DOJ Inspector General report; the cause of death is attributed both ways (NYC medical examiner suicide ruling + FBI no-criminality vs. Dr. Baden's homicide doubt). The body-double / 'shipped to Israel' / Fortnite-login-from-Tel-Aviv material is comedic invention with no primary trace (Group C); the 'Fortnite login' was checked against our own EFTA corpus and is not in the released files. The murder-vs-suicide dispute itself is the one genuinely contested framing (Group B).
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
